estimand: Retrospective terminal-lineup adjusted points per 100 possessions.

analytic_diagnostic.method: CR0 game-cluster sandwich for ridge coefficients

agreement_gate.additional_requirement: no systematic offensive or defensive coverage failure

required_outputs: offense estimate, standard error, 80% and 95% interval, probability above zero
defense estimate, standard error, 80% and 95% interval, probability above zero
net estimate, standard error, 80% and 95% interval, probability above zero
bootstrap draw coverage and uncertainty status
invariants: offense + defense = net in every point estimate and bootstrap draw
players absent from a component in a draw have missing draw values
